question: What part of the L=5 square LER curve is controlled by the auxiliary-partition prediction, and where do existing exact-posterior Monte Carlo anchors leave the analytic curve unresolved?
claim_boundary: Synthesis of existing evidence only. No new physical samples, decoder run, fit, interpolation, threshold, phase boundary, monotonicity claim, or numerical pooling of deterministic certificates with Monte Carlo intervals.

selection.oracle_rule: Use exact conditional Bayes risks averaged over independent physical records with the registered pointwise bootstrap 95% interval; q=.97 is available only at p=.30.
selection.certificate_rule: Use k=4 activity lower/upper bounds at p=.02,.05. At p=.08 retain activity bounds for q=.5,.75 and replace only the upper bound for promoted q=.97,1 cells with the B=1024 adaptive bound.
selection.leading_term_rule: Show the preregistered dilute leading monomial only at the three certified p values as a separate marker, never as a connected curve.

presentation.panels: one panel per q, common log-LER scale, no connecting lines
presentation.unresolved_region: Shade p>=.08 in q=.5,.75 panels and label it analytic prediction unresolved; sampled exact-posterior anchors remain descriptive evidence, not a fitted continuation.

acceptance: Every displayed value is copied from a frozen input and identified as deterministic certificate, dilute leading term, or exact-posterior Monte Carlo estimate.
The figure contains no fitted or interpolated curve and visually separates certificates from Monte Carlo intervals.
The fair/intermediate p>=.08 analytic region is explicitly unresolved; near-directed p=.08 uses only promoted bounds.
Machine-readable synthesis records source hashes, integrity checks, selected values, and claim limits.
The exact PNG is embedded in REPORT.md and exposed once in lab.json; report and Wiki lints pass and the rendered PNG is visually inspected.
stop_rule: Stop after one evidence-boundary synthesis. Do not collect more samples or reopen contraction priorities in this transition.
decision: The controlled prediction is certified through p=.05 for all registered q and narrowed at p=.08 only for q=.97,1. Fair/intermediate p>=.08 remains analytically unresolved; existing exact-posterior anchors are not a fitted continuation.
